title: Squishmallows’ ‘KPop Demon Hunters’ Collection Features 4 Fan-Favorite Characters in Plushie Form
summary: The obsession with KPop Demon Hunters continues with this new collection of plush toys.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

Netflix’s KPop Demon Hunters quickly became one of the streamer’s biggest animated hits, earning widespread acclaim for its animation, Grammy-winning K-pop music , and memorable cast of heroes and villains. The film’s massive global success has transformed it into a full-fledged merchandising powerhouse, with fans eagerly collecting everything from apparel to toys inspired by HUNTR/X and the supernatural world they protect.

Jazwares is among the latest companies to expand the franchise with an officially licensed KPop Demon Hunters Squishmallows collection. The collaboration introduces four fan-favorite characters in plush form: Rumi, Jinu, Sussie, and Derpy. The lineup joins Jazwares’ growing range of KPop Demon Hunters products, with the company also planning additional plush and BumBumz inspired by the film for global retailers.

FAN-FAVORITE CHARACTER

Squishmallows KPop Demon Hunters Rumi Plush

$15.99

Buy Now On Amazon

Rumi headlines the collection as an eight-inch Squishmallows plush made with the brand’s signature ultrasoft fabric.

The design shows off Rumi’s most recognizable features, including her embroidered mismatched eyes and woven purple braid. Her coffee-brown right eye represents her human side, while the glowing amber left eye symbolizes her demon heritage as a human-demon hybrid (cambion).

HUNTR/X RIVAL

Squishmallows KPop Demon Hunters Jinu Plush

Jinu’s standout detail is his traditional Korean gat, which has been incorporated into the plush design to mirror his on-screen look.

Jinu joins the Squishmallows lineup in an eight-inch plush that captures his signature appearance from the film. Like every release in the collection, it is an officially-licensed Netflix product crafted from Squishmallows’ ultrasoft material and features the official Squishmallows seal for collectors.

SUPERNATURAL MAGPIE

Squishmallows KPop Demon Hunters Sussie Plush

$14.99

Sussie makes their Squishmallows debut as an eight-inch plush featuring a distinctive traditional black gat.

Sussie’s compact size makes it ideal for display alongside the rest of the KPop Demon Hunters Squishmallows collection.

MAGICAL BLUE TIGER

Squishmallows KPop Demon Hunters Derpy Plush

Squishmallows recreates the beloved tiger’s signature striped tail, one of the defining details fans will immediately recognize.

Constructed from Squishmallows’ ultrasoft material, Derpy joins Rumi, Jinu, and Sussie as part of the franchise’s first wave of collectible plushies.

COMING SOON

BumBumz 4-Pack KPop Demon Hunters: Light Stick, White Couch, Ramen & Derpy

Pre-Order Now

$19.99

Also from Jazwares is the KPop Demon Hunters BumBumz lineup, from the makers of the original Squishmallows.

Scheduled for release on Aug. 20 and currently available for pre-order on Amazon, the BumBumz set includes plush versions of the Light Stick, White Couch, Ramen and Derpy, transforming memorable items and characters from the film into quirky collectibles. Sized at 4.5 inches, the plushes are designed for easy display, travel, or desk décor.

The Squishmallows launch is just one of several major merch collaborations following the movie’s breakout success, alongside Mattel KPop Demon Hunters dolls , Hasbro’s NERF role-play weapons and Furby collectibles, Little People Collector set , Old Navy apparel, Vans footwear and other officially licensed products that continue to expand the franchise beyond the screen.

PHYSICAL RELEASE

KPop Demon Hunters DVD (Blu-ray + 4K Ultra HD)

$49.95

Fans who want to have the DVD as a collectible can pre-order KPop Demon Hunters from The Criterion Collection in Blu-ray and 4K Ultra HD editions. The release is currently listed for December 31, 2026.

The physical edition marks another milestone in the film’s continued popularity, giving collectors a premium home-video release to pair with the growing lineup of official merchandise. Details on possible bonus features have not been released yet, but The Criterion Collection’s DVDs tend to include deleted scenes, bonus material, and audio and visual updates.
